cases.name: Destiny Briana Duckett
cases.narrative: On 2/13/2023, police conducted a welfare check when her cousin said no one answered the door and that she could hear a child crying inside. Duckett was found deceased on the floor with a 2-month-old boy on a bed "screaming and crying." Positional asphyxiation.
